    • wrap

      public static List<String> wrap(String text, FontMetrics fm, int width)
      Splits text into lines that fit a width, breaking at the allowed line break points (spaces and hyphens) and at newline characters.
      Parameters:
      text - the text
      fm - the metrics of the font that will draw it
      width - the maximum line width in pixels
      Returns:
      the lines

      public static int drawWrapped(Graphics2D g, String text, int x, int y, int width, int lineHeight)
      Draws wrapped text.
      Parameters:
      g - the graphics
      text - the text
      x - left edge
      y - baseline of the first line
      width - maximum line width
      lineHeight - distance between baselines
      Returns:
      the y of the baseline after the last line
